$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — C1-C5 (CE-2152) the squad's casualty-care drill. From the header's Judge (2)-(4): the check drops Rifleman 3 to 25 HP at contact (the live check's set_health; contact = the first round at the Hostile), the Medic and only he carries, covering rounds precede him, the man is carried then put down alive. 'Medic goes' is his CarryCasualty task, so 'covering fire first' is stricter than the live '1 m out'. NOT expressed: (1) Rescue winning the decision (an unreadable utility winner), (4) the squad leaving CasualtyCare (a task cue cannot be negated), (5) no order to the man down and the 2.5 m cover-point distance (maneuver data read over HTTP, not components). The take never fired its cues (it had no action).
